activation_rule: Merchant reviews edits, sets review_status to approved, then sets runtime_eligible to true.

summary.ar: يمكن طلب إرجاع مؤهل خلال 14 يوماً من الاستلام. تختلف المسؤولية والإجراء بحسب ما إذا كان المنتج تالفاً أو معيباً، أو كان الطلب بسبب تغيير الرأي.
summary.en: An eligible return can be requested within 14 days of delivery. Responsibility and process differ for damaged or defective items versus change-of-mind returns.

damaged_or_defective.ar: بحسب السياسة، يتواصل العميل فوراً، ويتولى المتجر ترتيب استبدال مجاني دون تكلفة شحن على العميل.
damaged_or_defective.en: Under the policy, the customer should contact the store immediately, and the store arranges a free replacement with no shipping cost to the customer.

eligibility_conditions: receipt or proof of purchase available
contact the store before sending anything back

exchange.replacement_sent_after: returned item is received and inspected

not_eligible: damage caused by customer misuse, stains, or tears

bot_rules: Answer general policy questions without asking for personal order data.
For an actual return, refund, exchange, cancellation, or replacement, verify the order and create a human-reviewed case.
Do not promise approval, payment timing beyond the stated estimate, or an exception.
Do not reuse historical cancellation or order-change claims; verify live order state.
Do not expose a return address or email from historical pages; use the configured handoff channel because contact details conflict across official pages.
